items.title: JPMorgan, Visa, and Mastercard disclose cyberattack on third-party vendors
items.summary: JPMorgan Chase, Visa, and Mastercard said on Thursday that some select customer data, including emails, was accessed by attackers after a cyberattack on a vendor.

items.title: Vendor attack exposes JPMorgan Reserve cardholder emails
items.summary: About 16,700 Reserve card member records, with emails and ZIP codes but no names, sit in the JPMorgan files. No company has named any vendor.

items.title: Visa, Mastercard and JPMorgan Customer Data Leaked by Hackers
items.summary: The incident involved data belonging to thousands of customers, but it isn’t disrupting payment services or connected to banking issues earlier this week.

items.title: Hackers Leak Visa, Mastercard and JPMorgan Customer Data
items.summary: A ransomware group breached third-party vendors, not the companies’ own systems. Visa said no card data was affected while Mastercard cited a limited cardholder subset.
